## Activity

Capture activity at River Outreach during April 2025 was completed as planned, with 66 captures recorded. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Overall, activity was maintained across the reporting period, with no operational issue identified in the information provided. The recorded capture volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 5 ungradable captures. The ungradable_rate was 7.6. These cases were excluded from interpretation because the images did not meet the requirements for grading. The result is noted for routine monitoring and ongoing review of capture practice.

## Grading

A total of 4 captures were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 0, indicating that grading was completed without a measurable delay during the period. The grading outcome should be considered alongside the ungradable findings when reviewing site performance for April 2025. Overall, the available results show continued activity at River Outreach, with image-quality findings and referable results documented for follow-up through the usual operational processes.
